# Pre-market brief, Wed 2026-10-28 (as of ~8:15 AM ET)

1. **Fed 2 PM, Warsh presser 2:30.** Hold at 3.75–4.00% expected; watch for hawkish tilt on sticky inflation and oil ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-wednesday-october-28-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-fed-meeting-decision-080642111.html)). Thu 8:30 GDP/PCE, ECB 9:15; Fri ECI.
2. **Futures mixed, chips lead.** ~8:10 AM: ES +0.11% (7,767), NQ +0.36%, YM −0.27%, RTY −0.22%; VIX 17.5; 10y 4.99%; WTI $101.91 (+2%); BTC ~$81.1k (+1%) ([Regards of Wallstreet](https://www.regardsofwallstreet.com/premarket)). SK Hynix op profit +632% y/y lifts memory: MU +4%, WDC +4.5%, STX −3.7% after its print ([Reuters via Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/nasdaq-futures-rise-as-sk-hynix-boosts-chips-before-fed-decision-earnings-4978026)). GOOGL +1.2% on report OpenAI to buy its AI chips (same).
3. **After close: MSFT, GOOGL, NOW, TMUS** (also F, EBAY, CMG). Options imply GOOGL ±6.1%, MSFT ±5.3% ([Regards of Wallstreet](https://www.regardsofwallstreet.com/premarket)). Thu: AMZN, INTC, COIN, SBUX AMC; LLY, CAT BMO.
4. **Movers** ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-vertiv-sk-hynix-jump-enphase-nxp-slide-4978698)): VRT +15% (beat, FY EPS guide $7.15 vs $6.73 cons.); GEHC +5.4% (beat and raise); UCTT +12%; GEV +2.5% on beat, raised guide, buyback to $20B ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/ge-vernova-stock-gains-on-earnings-beat-raised-guidance-4978247); [GEV PR](https://www.gevernova.com/sites/default/files/gev_webcast_pressrelease_10282026.pdf)). ENPH −16% (miss, Q4 guide $225–255M vs ~$300M) drags SEDG −7%; NXPI −8.5% (soft Q4 guide); BSX −3.6% (FY EPS cut to $3.16–3.18, Q4 sales to fall 1–3%); FFIV −6.6% (FY27 margin guide); HOOD −6 to −7% extends AH slide ([Stocksetups](https://stocksetups.com/movers/premarket)).

Signals: added ENPH, SEDG (solar group), NXPI, BSX, FFIV avoids; dropped WDC avoid (memory rally reversed the capex scare).

## Swing ideas
- **GEV** long, med. Orders +96% organic, backlog $197B, 2026 guide raised, buyback doubled to $20B; modest +2.5% gap. Risk: crowded AI-power trade; MSFT/GOOGL capex read tonight.
- **MU** long, low. SK Hynix record quarter confirms memory pricing; +4% pre. Risk: semis whipsaw on hyperscaler capex and Fed tone.
